responsibility: Implements low-level GNU Modula-2 runtime exception hookup to host OS signals in the mc bootstrap library. It stores language-level exception handler callbacks, installs sigaction handlers for SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, and SIGFPE when supported, and dispatches signal conditions such as invalid memory access and arithmetic faults to the corresponding Modula-2 runtime exception procedures; otherwise it provides a no-op initialization stub and the required module init/fini symbols.
